result:
Two real bugs, one fragility, in `app/inventory.py` (read only, not run; no file changed).

`merge`, line 13: `total[sku] = qty` overwrites instead of summing → repeated SKUs keep the last quantity, not the total. Docstring says sum. Fix: `total[sku] += qty`.

`low_stock`, line 19: `qty < threshold` excludes SKUs exactly at the threshold; docstring says "at or below". Fix: `qty <= threshold`.

`value`, line 24: `prices[sku]` raises `KeyError` for any stocked SKU with no price. Also float prices → `round(..., 2)` can land a cent off on sums; `Decimal` or integer cents if exactness matters. Neither contradicts the docstring, so this is a judgment call, not a definite bug.

Separately: chisle statusline badge isn't configured. Want me to add it to `settings.json`?
